name: Strength (bodyweight)
description: Goblet sq 3×12, single-leg RDL 3×10, Bulgarian split sq 3×8, calf raises 3×15, side plank 3×30s

name: Strength (heavy)
description: Sprint-prep: Back sq 4×4 @ 80-85% 1RM (2-3min rest), Bulgarian split sq w/ DB 3×6/side heavy, Barbell hip thrust 3×5 heavy, Explosive step-ups 3×5/side (fast), Plank 3×45s. Full recovery between sets.

name: Strength (maintenance)
description: Maintenance, once a week: Back sq 3×4 @ 85% 1RM, Barbell hip thrust 3×5 heavy, Bulgarian split sq 2×6/side. Full recovery. Keep the load, drop the volume.

name: Strength (power)
description: Race-season power: Back sq 3×3 @ 85-90% 1RM, Trap-bar jumps 4×5 (light bar, max speed), Box jumps 3×5, Explosive step-ups 3×5/side, Hip thrust 2×5 heavy. Full recovery. Quality over volume, never to failure.
